title: Audit log
subtitleOrg: Append-only record of changes and sensitive actions in {workspace}. Nobody can edit or delete a row, Owners included.
subtitlePlatform: Append-only record across all tenants. Personal fields are masked. Rows written during a support session carry its id.
piiMasked: Personal data and IP addresses are masked for your role.
appendOnly: Audit rows cannot be edited or deleted by anyone.
emptyBody: Changes to records, roles, configuration and exports appear here as they happen.
emptyFilteredBody: Widen the date range or clear a filter.
errorMessage: The audit log could not be read. Nothing was changed. Try again; if it keeps failing, give support the request id.
deniedTitle: You cannot read the audit log
deniedBody: Reading the audit log needs the audit.read permission. Ask an Owner to grant it.
deniedPlatformBody: Reading the platform audit log needs the platform.read permission.
exportDisabledSupport: Export is blocked during a support session.
exportDoneSub: The export is itself recorded in the audit log.
exportTruncated: Exported the newest {n} audit events; narrow the filters to get the rest
exportDemo: Demo: the filtered audit log would be exported as CSV. Nothing was written.
exportSupportBlocked: Export is blocked during a support session.
exportAuditFailed: Export cancelled: the export could not be recorded in the audit log, so nothing was downloaded.
exportFailed: The audit export failed. Nothing was downloaded.
tenantTabSub: Rows written inside a support session carry its id.
demoNote: Demo data. Nothing here is stored.
recordInvalid: The audit entry was not valid.
recordFailed: The audit entry could not be written.
